hero.headline: Give work to AI.
hero.body: Build a supervised AI workforce for the work your organization already does. Define the role, assign the job, connect the tools and see every important decision.

workspace.headline: People and AI, in one clear structure.
workspace.body: Workers, their jobs and the decisions waiting for a person, side by side.

approval.title: Post stakeholder update
approval.body: The operations coordinator asked to send a Slack message. The run is paused while a reviewer checks the request and its context.

workforce.headline: Make the work clear before it begins.
workforce.body: A useful AI worker needs more than a prompt. Give it a role, working hours and a named supervisor, and give each job an objective, requirements and a clear definition of done.

profile.job: Gather relevant sources, summarize findings and deliver a structured brief.

points: A separate security identity for every worker

runtime.headline: From assignment to a traceable result.
runtime.body: Jobs enter a durable queue. Runs have steps, checkpoints, retries and a recorded outcome, so work can be followed instead of guessed at.

steps.title: Assess completion
steps.detail: Compare the result with the job criteria

intelligence.headline: Intelligence where it helps.
intelligence.body: Audoryn routes each kind of AI work to models suited to it. A model can reason about the task; Audoryn still controls what may happen outside it.

items.title: Planning and coordination
items.body: Models help plan managed runs, prepare jobs and resolve which tools a task needs, within a fixed time and usage budget.

items.title: Working with your workers
items.body: Talk to a worker about its job in plain language; the answer comes back in the same conversation.

items.title: Visual understanding
items.body: Uploaded images can be analysed and the relevant findings returned for the task.

items.title: Analysis, not authority
items.body: Models never receive provider credentials or direct access to connected tools. Every action still passes capability, policy and approval.

supervision.headline: The moments that matter come back to a person.
supervision.body: Policy can allow, deny or hold an action for review. A held run waits while a person sees the context, decides, and leaves a record.

integrations.headline: Work across the tools your team already uses.
integrations.body: Connect workplace systems to Audoryn's governed action gateway. Each provider exposes defined capabilities.
integrations.note: A connection alone never gives a worker permission to act. Available operations depend on provider setup, declared capabilities and policy.

closing.headline: Bring AI into the workflow.
closing.body: Start small, make authority explicit and grow the workforce as the work proves useful.
